reason: One saved assessment feedback path contradicted the guide’s safe ground-shadow instructions by asking the pupil to look through candidate materials towards the Sun. Replace that instruction with observing the cast shadow on the ground and an actual shaded/unshaded temperature comparison.
before: Hold candidate materials up to the sun and pick the one you can't see through; test which casts the darkest shadow.
after: Place each cover above the target and compare its cast shadow on the ground; never look towards the Sun or through a candidate material at it. Then compare actual shaded and unshaded temperature readings over the same time rather than assuming a darker shadow alone proves reduced warming.
preservation: Complete claim, evidence, contexts, ages, edges, guide activities, flags, sources, confidence and provenance remain unchanged. This correction adds no new criterion and makes no automatic learner equivalence/reset/transfer.

source.scope: Supports rejecting improvised direct viewing. This shade task involves no direct solar viewing or eclipse observation.
